_what: Verbatim measured Magento/Adobe-Commerce GraphQL response bodies for tests/test_magento_gql_adapter.py (UNIT B3, ENABLE_MAGENTO_GQL_ADAPTER). Each file is the JSON body a POST https://<host>/graphql with a products(filter:{url_key:{eq:...}}) query returned, copied VERBATIM from the B4 side-door probes. Nothing here is authored except no_match_empty_control.json.
_mechanism: url_key = last URL path segment minus '.html'. POST body {"query": "{products(filter:{url_key:{eq:\"<url_key>\"}}){total_count items{name sku price_range{minimum_price{final_price{value currency} regular_price{value currency}}}}}}"}. The response's price_range.minimum_price.{final_price,regular_price}.{value,currency} is the sale/list price + genuine currency. final_price is the sale price (sale-vs-list contract).
_measurement: B4 sidedoor_probes.json / sidedoor_probes2.json (scratchpad research/B4), measured live 3/3 from the Bahrain residential IP, robots-checked, >=2.5s/host throttle. arenal 737ms, jomashop 648ms, paco 651ms. On jomashop.com the GraphQL POST returns 200 while the HTML PDP route is Cloudflare-403-walled — the side-door walks past the wall.

arenal_gentleman_society_ambree_eur.json.measured: final_price 51.45 EUR / regular_price 105 EUR, total_count 1. Adapter converts to BHD via FALLBACK_RATES['EUR']=0.41 -> source_method converted_usd, original_currency EUR.
arenal_gentleman_society_ambree_eur.json.kept: the response body VERBATIM (name 'Gentleman Society Ambree', sku 9411, both price nodes).

jomashop_gade_icon_roses_usd.json.measured: final_price 46.99 USD (regular == final), total_count 1, while the HTML PDP route is Cloudflare-walled. Adapter converts via FALLBACK_RATES['USD']=0.376 -> converted_usd, original_currency USD.
jomashop_gade_icon_roses_usd.json.kept: the response body VERBATIM (the full barcode-suffixed name, sku Y-A459H, both price nodes).

paco_calvin_klein_eternity_gbp.json.measured: final_price 42.5 GBP / regular_price 89 GBP, total_count 1. Adapter converts via FALLBACK_RATES['GBP']=0.475 -> converted_usd, original_currency GBP.
paco_calvin_klein_eternity_gbp.json.kept: the response body VERBATIM (name 'Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray', sku 088300601400, both price nodes).

no_match_empty_control.json.measured: The genuine empty shape a url_key with no match returns: total_count 0, items []. Measured on paco for url_key 'omnia-crystalline' (sidedoor_probes.json paco_magento_graphql). Pins that a 200-but-no-item response yields None (no fabrication), so flag-ON adds recovery only when a product actually matches.
